prompt:
Implement this service.

<spec>
name: job-queue-api
description: A FIFO job queue with enqueue, dequeue and acknowledge.
endpoints:
- method: GET
  path: /health
- method: GET
  path: /metrics
- method: POST
  path: /jobs
  description: 'enqueue body {id: non-empty string, payload: any}; 201 on success;
    409 if id already exists; 400 if id missing'
- method: POST
  path: /jobs/dequeue
  description: 200 with the oldest queued job {id, payload} and mark it in-flight;
    204 if the queue is empty
- method: POST
  path: /jobs/{id}/ack
  description: 200 if the job was in-flight; 404 if unknown; 409 if it is not in-flight
metrics:
- name: queue_depth
  type: gauge
  help: Jobs waiting (not in-flight)
- name: jobs_enqueued_total
  type: counter
  help: Jobs accepted
- name: jobs_acked_total
  type: counter
  help: Jobs acknowledged
behaviors:
- Dequeue order is first-in first-out
probes:
- method: POST
  path: /jobs
  expect_status:
  - 201
  body: '{"id": "a", "payload": 1}'
- method: POST
  path: /jobs
  expect_status:
  - 409
  body: '{"id": "a", "payload": 1}'
- method: POST
  path: /jobs
  expect_status:
  - 400
  body: '{"payload": 1}'
- method: POST
  path: /jobs/dequeue
  expect_status:
  - 200
  body: '{}'
- method: POST
  path: /jobs/a/ack
  expect_status:
  - 200
  body: '{}'
- method: POST
  path: /jobs/zzz/ack
  expect_status:
  - 404
  body: '{}'
</spec>

Already provided by templates (do NOT write or register these):
- main.go: `func newServer() http.Handler` serves GET /health and GET /metrics, then calls
  `registerRoutes(mux)`. Do not register /health or /metrics yourself.
- metrics.go: Prometheus variables you must keep up to date from your handlers:
- queueDepth  (gauge) -> exposed as `queue_depth`; use Set/Inc/Dec/Add
- jobsEnqueuedTotal  (counter) -> exposed as `jobs_enqueued_total`; use Inc/Add
- jobsAckedTotal  (counter) -> exposed as `jobs_acked_total`; use Inc/Add

You must write these files:
1. handlers.go - defines `func registerRoutes(mux *http.ServeMux)` that registers ONLY these routes:
   - POST /jobs  enqueue body {id: non-empty string, payload: any}; 201 on success; 409 if id already exists; 400 if id missing
   - POST /jobs/dequeue  200 with the oldest queued job {id, payload} and mark it in-flight; 204 if the queue is empty
   - POST /jobs/{id}/ack  200 if the job was in-flight; 404 if unknown; 409 if it is not in-flight
   Keep state in memory (you may add store.go). Return JSON with proper status codes; reject
   malformed input with 400. The behaviors in the spec are verified at runtime.
2. handlers_test.go - at least 3 `func TestXxx(t *testing.T)` functions using
   net/http/httptest against `newServer()`. Never bind real ports; tests must finish in seconds.
3. README.md - must contain: an "## Endpoints" section listing EVERY spec endpoint (including
   /health and /metrics) as `METHOD /path` in backticks, and a "## Metrics" section listing EVERY
   metric name in backticks. Only document things that actually exist.
